title: What depends_on waits for
statement: In compose.yaml, service web has `depends_on: [db]` (short syntax) and db is postgres:16 with no healthcheck. What does `docker compose up` guarantee?
choices: web is started only after Postgres accepts connections
db's container is started before web's container, but Postgres may not be ready to accept connections yet
web and db start in parallel; depends_on only affects the order of `docker compose down`
web is restarted automatically until it manages to connect to db
